description: This Java class 'PostgresEdgeEventService' handles asynchronous saving of edge events in a database, manages executor lifecycle, and publishes events upon successful save, with optional statistics tracking.

classes.name: PostgresEdgeEventService
classes.description: Service class for handling asynchronous edge event persistence, executor management, and event publishing.

methods.name: initExecutor
methods.description: Initializes the single-thread executor for handling edge event tasks.

methods.name: shutdownExecutor
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service gracefully.

methods.name: saveAsync
methods.description: Validates and asynchronously saves an EdgeEvent, then updates stats and publishes an event upon success.
